Like.title: Anomaly Like Count
Like.description: Stores the total number of likes for a specific map anomaly.

updatedAt.description: Last time the like count was updated.

Submission.title: User Map Submission
Submission.description: A pending or approved submission created by users for the interactive map layers.

name.description: Name / title of the coordinate anomaly.

category.description: The category of this submission (layer association).

description.description: Detailed description of narrative, events, or intelligence metadata.

date.description: Date or year associated with the incident. (e.g., '1947' or '2026')

coordinates.description: Coordinates [lng, lat] for the map point registration.

images.description: Array of media URLs linked or uploaded (images, videos, pdfs, audio).

source.description: Optional attribution or investigative reporter identifier.

/likes/{anomalyId}.description: Collection of like counts indexed by anomaly ID.

/submissions/{submissionId}.description: Collection of submissions or proposed features on the interactive map.
